rationale.A: Via Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu (260 m in traffic, unsignalised Mannerheimintie crossing), Meilahti, then Kuusisaarentie path; 11 lights
rationale.B: Central Park route (Auroransilta, Ratsastie, Tilkanvierto), no traffic, then Kuusisaarentie path; four unsignalised crossings; 4 lights
rationale.C: Same as B via Hammarskjöldintie; 4 lights
rationale.D: Same as A via Meilahdentie; 10 lights
rationale.E: Through Töölö: 80 m tram traffic and several unsignalised crossings incl. Paciuksenkatu; 9 lights
rationale.F: Same Central Park route; fewest unsignalised crossings (2); no traffic; 3 lights; +2 min
rationale.H: Central Park, then Tilkka streets and paths; no traffic; +9 min

notes: F at +2 min saves 8 lights and moves about 2 km from arterial-side riding and Mannerheimintie/Tukholmankatu traffic into Central Park. All routes share the ~2.5 km Kuusisaarentie roadside path, so every tier is C.
